name: Monkeys Curse
summary: In "Monkeys Curse," the very essence of fear permeates every vine, and the jungle itself is your relentless tormentor. Will you succumb to the malevolence of the curse, or will you find the strength to break free from the clutches of the relentless horrors that haunt this cursed realm? The jungle's darkest secrets await your discovery, but be forewarned: once you enter, there may be no returning to the light.
